_comment: Flag-name fix: this ability read a flag NOTHING ever set, so it could never fire. The engine records fusion as "fused_<slug>" (ability_keywords.fusion), boost as "boosted_this_turn", and a played Lightning card as "played_lightning" — all lowercase. Was: FUSED. Turn-event tracking: read DEALT_ARCANE_DAMAGE_TO_OPPONENT — private flag(s) nothing ever set, so the clause could never fire. The canonical keyword functions now record what happened this turn and EVENT_THIS_TURN reads it.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran. WHILE_STATIC is re-evaluated on every attack-power recalculation. SOURCE_IS_ATTACK confines it to this card's own attack.
